profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I love leveraging resources, exploring the boundaries of technology and tools, and coaching people on how to use the technology around them effectively!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built tools for contractors and trained contractors on Kiewit specific knowledge and databases.
- Created and validated scripts for Databricks and Snowflake migration.
- Managed big data validation for billion record tables.
- Provided mentoring on best practices for automation and collaborative software engineering.
- Managed onboarding new employees in backend software development and project operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Designed and managed project management operations for backend web-development.
•  Designed and developed the backend for web applications used to automate construction processes.
•  Validated engineering work processes and developed algorithms to preform the same behavior.
•  Created a system for processing, managing, and tracking customer issues for web based applications.
•  Created and managed production support for web based applications as lead technical support engineer.

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description: Skills: Data Preparation · Data Science · Research Skills · Machine Learning · Writing · Databases · Microsoft Azure · Azure Data Lake · Analytics · Data Visualization · Fact-checking

positions.title: Post Graduate – Transformation Analyst
positions.description:
•	Designed and led project for GE Healthcare to recapture $1.2 million in a 4 month span.
•	Originated a system to mitigate billing errors and trained a contractor to monitor the process after my tenure
•	Visualized and documented trends and anomalies to aid future verification of billing data
positions.insights: Skills: Reporting Requirements · Data Preparation · Data Science · Research Skills · Writing · Databases · Business Requirements · Analytics · Data Visualization · Fact-checking

positions.title: Management and Operations Reporting
positions.description:
•	Created and maintained interactive financial dashboards for executive team and district leads for 60 districts.
•	Streamlined reporting methods by implementing automation and helpful coding practices.
•	Analyzed, visualized, and explained overhead costs for operations management team.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Preparation · Data Science · Research Skills · Writing · Databases · Microsoft Azure · Azure Data Lake · Analytics · Data Visualization · Fact-checking
